title: Workflows lack least-privilege token permissions and SHA-pinned actions
expected: Every workflow declares permissions (default contents: read); third-party and first-party actions are pinned to commit SHAs with Dependabot updates.
actual: Five workflows, including deploy.yml (production secrets), have no permissions block, so the token gets the repository default. All actions use major tags (actions/checkout@v7 etc.).
impact: A compromised step or action tag would run with broader token rights than needed during deploys.
fix: Add top-level permissions: contents: read (grant more per job only where needed); pin actions to SHAs with a version comment; enable Dependabot for github-actions.
